quest.title: Buyer's Guide to the Statue of Her Excellency, the Almighty Narukami Ogosho, God of Thunder
quest.description: Something appears to have occurred in front of Eipekkusu, the place where Statues of Her Excellency, the Almighty Narukami Ogosho, God of Thunder are being sold...
quest.rewards_formatted: Primogem x40, Mora x20000, Hero's Wit x2, Exquisite Gift (Furnishing) x1

dialogues.speaker: Kujou Sara
dialogues.text: The Five Kasen Plaza is significantly less crowded now, but it's still too early to relax. This is a serious matter, and we must remain vigilant. Is that clear?

dialogues.speaker: Haruto
dialogues.text: Yes, Ma'am!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hey! Sara—

dialogues.speaker: Kujou Sara
dialogues.text: Oh, it's you. Do you have something to report?

response.speaker: Kujou Sara
response.text: Really? Good.

response.speaker: Kujou Sara
response.text: The Tenryou Commission has a responsibility to ensure public order and security during the Irodori Festival. If anything comes up, come to me.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Oh, you look really busy. Has something serious happened?

response.speaker: Kujou Sara
response.text: Nothing serious, really. We've just received a lot of reports in the past few days over things like line-cutting, reselling goods at inflated prices...

response.speaker: Kujou Sara
response.text: Even trouble makers hogging the photo board. All minor incidents, but it all adds up to create of lot of work for a lot of people.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Sounds tough...

response.speaker: Kujou Sara
response.text: Still, I take the fact that so many people are turning to us for assistance as a sign that the Tenryou Commission is gradually regaining the people's trust.

response.speaker: Kujou Sara
response.text: The Shogun gave us orders to provide security at the Irodori Festival. This is a rare chance to change people's perception of the Tenryou Commission, so we cannot afford to slip up. Even if it's tiring work, we must rise to the challenge.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Well, no matter how busy you are, at least you still found some time to come here and buy an Almighty Shogun figurine, right? We want to buy one too.

response.speaker: Kujou Sara
response.text: What do you mean, figurine... Ahem, I'm just patrolling these parts. In fact, I was just about to leave.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Heehee, no need to be shy! Actually, Miko told us that you got up super early this one time to make sure you could be first in line to buy one of these figurines!

response.speaker: Kujou Sara
response.text: That Lady Guuji, how could she disclose... Hmph, never mind.

response.speaker: Kujou Sara
response.text: To be clear, I have no intention to hide that which I do out of reverence alone. But there is one thing you must be corrected on.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Oh? What is it?

response.speaker: Kujou Sara
response.text: That is not a "figurine." It's a Statue of Her Excellency, the Almighty Narukami Ogosho, God of Thunder. Do I make myself clear?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Almighty Naru... Narukami Ogo... Ogo... got it.

response.speaker: Kujou Sara
response.text: This particular Statue of Her Excellency, the Almighty Narukami Ogosho, God of Thunder is a brand-new edition. There will only be 300 available in this batch, and there is a limit of one per customer.

response.speaker: Kujou Sara
response.text: Many people have been lining up since well before dawn to acquire one. I'm afraid if you're only showing up now, you're probably too late.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Oh, really? So... so you definitely must have gotten here pretty early too, then. Did you manage to get one yet?

response.speaker: Kujou Sara
response.text: Normally, of course, I would come to purchase one myself. But on this occasion, my duties at the Irodori Festival had to take priority.

response.speaker: Kujou Sara
response.text: We are required to report for duty long before the shops open. It is regrettable, but I had no choice but to forgo the chance this time...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Aw... What a shame...

response.speaker: Kujou Sara
response.text: So instead, I had someone purchase one on my behalf.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Oh, right! Wait, you can do that?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Didn't you say they're limited to one per customer? This figurine is super popular... It must be pretty tough to find someone happy to buy one for you and not for themselves!

response.speaker: Kujou Sara
response.text: I anticipated the same, at first. But Lady Guuji Yae found a professional to assist me, saying she appreciated our tireless efforts during the festival period.

response.speaker: Kujou Sara
response.text: I don't know who the professional is. I assume it would be either someone from the Grand Narukami Shrine or from the Yashiro Commission, but I did not ask. Given the time, I believe they should have completed the purchase by now.

response.speaker: Kujou Sara
response.text: I am fortunate to have had Lady Guuji's help this time. I likely would have struggled to find a candidate on my own.

response.speaker: Kujou Sara
response.text: As well as being willing, they would need to be an early riser and also tall enough to beat the crowds to the top-shelf items...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: "Early riser" and "tall"...

response.speaker: Kujou Sara
response.text: Hm? What was that sound?

response.speaker: Kujou Sara
response.text: #Really... Well, never mind. I have been here long enough, it's time for me to head to my next patrol zone. Stay safe during the Irodori Festival, {NICKNAME}.

response.speaker: Kujou Sara
response.text: It's fine. As long as it's been taken care of.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Sorry for the inconvenience caused.

response.speaker: Kujou Sara
response.text: This is my duty. I don't see it as an inconvenience.

dialogues.speaker: Sayu
dialogues.text: Uh oh... you found me.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Sayu! What are you doing here? ...Oh, wait... Are you the "professional"?

dialogues.speaker: Sayu
dialogues.text: Shh! Quiet, she might still be in earshot!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Sayu... have you been slacking off again?

dialogues.speaker: Sayu
dialogues.text: No way! I've been here since last night so I could buy a figurine. But after waiting and waiting, my eyes started to feel real droopy, and...

dialogues.speaker: Sayu
dialogues.text: I only meant to take a short nap, a really quick one!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: In short, you overslept.

dialogues.speaker: Sayu
dialogues.text: Ohh... If I don't buy one of these figurines, the Tenryou Commission tengu will lock me up for life!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Surely not...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Sheesh, goodness knows what Miko told you...

dialogues.speaker: Sayu
dialogues.text: I guess my only hope now is to sacrifice my salary for this month and buy one off someone who got here in time...

choices.text: Let me negotiate the price for you.

response.speaker: Sayu
response.text: Really? Great! Then... here's my salary, please don't spend it all!

choices.text: I'm good at driving a hard bargain.

dialogues.speaker: Konrad
dialogues.text: *sigh*... After coming all this way to Inazuma, and especially getting up early, I still walk away empty-handed.

dialogues.speaker: Konrad
dialogues.text: The first batch was smaller than I expected. And who knows when the next batch will come out.

dialogues.speaker: Konrad
dialogues.text: Well, since I'm here now... I guess I should buy some other souvenir instead...

dialogues.speaker: Reika
dialogues.text: Huh, you didn't manage to get one either? That's strange... When I came to line up this morning, I checked with my friend who'd already bought one.

dialogues.speaker: Reika
dialogues.text: She'd been lining up since before sunrise, and she was around the 100th in line. I was only 150 places behind her, so surely I should've gotten one.

dialogues.speaker: Reika
dialogues.text: Hmm... something's wrong here. I'm gonna go ask the shopkeeper for an explanation.

dialogues.speaker: Junpei
dialogues.text: Hehehe, why so glum — didn't manage to get your hands on a "Statue of Her Excellency, the Almighty Narukami Ogosho, God of Thunder" by any chance?

dialogues.speaker: Junpei
dialogues.text: Sell it? Huh, I ain't selling, not after all the effort I put in to get hold of this. Go ask someone else.

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text: You ask around in the area, but to no avail...

dialogues.speaker: Sayu
dialogues.text: I can't believe it. I am definitely done for this time...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: A whole load of people are saying they didn't manage to get one. Did the shopkeepers get the count wrong or something? Hmm... Oh, why don't we go ask at Eipekkusu?

dialogues.speaker: Sayu
dialogues.text: Mmm... Might as well. I guess there's nothing to lose...

talks.objective: Go to Eipekkusu and ask around

dialogues.speaker: Kaede
dialogues.text: ...Terribly sorry, I was otherwise occupied this morning, and had someone else watch the shop. So I don't know all the details, but according to our records, we did sell the full 300.

dialogues.speaker: Konrad
dialogues.text: Hey, what about those ones at the back? Aren't they for sale?

dialogues.speaker: Kaede
dialogues.text: I'm sorry, those are... those are display-only.

dialogues.speaker: Kaede
dialogues.text: Please don't be too disappointed. We are only selling a limited number of these statues at the festival, and this was only the first batch. Please rest assured you will all have the chance to purchase one in the future...

dialogues.speaker: Reika
dialogues.text: But when will the next batch be ready?

dialogues.speaker: Reika
dialogues.text: Also, this poor guy came all the way from Mondstadt. He got here earlier than me and was at least 50 places ahead of me.

dialogues.speaker: Reika
dialogues.text: Even he didn't get one. How do you explain these numbers?

dialogues.speaker: Konrad
dialogues.text: Look... I don't know a whole lot about Inazuman festivals, but... they do seem to have sold out pretty quickly.

dialogues.speaker: Kaede
dialogues.text: I'm terribly sorry, but I've triple-checked the sales records for this morning, and everything seems to be accounted for...

dialogues.speaker: Reika
dialogues.text: Hmm... Why don't we get the Tenryou Commission to investigate this?

dialogues.speaker: Sayu
dialogues.text: The... the Tenryou Commission? No, no way!

dialogues.speaker: Kaede
dialogues.text: Hmm? Sorry, who are you...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: This is the professional, from the Yashiro Commission.

dialogues.speaker: Reika
dialogues.text: Oh? Are you saying this falls under the Yashiro Commission's jurisdiction?

dialogues.speaker: Sayu
dialogues.text: Ummm... um... y—yeah, it does! We will follow up on this matter, so... so there's no need to go to the Tenryou Commission! They're busy enough as it is, haha, haha, hah...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Eh... that's weird, how come Sayu's so motivated to work all of a sudden?

dialogues.speaker: Sayu
dialogues.text: Shh! If the Tenryou Commission finds out about this, Kujou Sara will come ask me about it! And then, she'll find out that I didn't buy her figurine, and...

choices.text: Sayu is supposed to be Miko's hand-picked professional.

response.speaker: Sayu
response.text: A—Anyway, we can't get the Tenryou Commission involved, not unless there's no other way!

response.speaker: Reika
response.text: Huh... Well, since someone's already on the case, I suppose I'll just wait for the findings.

response.speaker: Konrad
response.text: Since I came all this way and didn't get a figurine, I guess I might as well look at what else is available.

response.speaker: Kaede
response.text: Thank you both for your understanding. We will make an announcement as soon as the results of the investigation come out.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Um, so we're supposed to be investigating, but we don't have any leads at all. Maybe the customers really did made a mistake with the count? If only we had a witness who'd been here the whole time...

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Technically, someone was here the whole time...

response.speaker: Sayu
response.text: You mean me...? Sorry, I was asleep...

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Did you hear anything in your sleep?

response.speaker: Sayu
response.text: Did I hear anything? Uh, let me think...

response.speaker: Konrad
response.text: ...I'll take these, please.

response.speaker: Kaede
response.text: Thank you for your patronage, please come again.

response.speaker: Sayu
response.text: "Thank you"... "patronage"... Oh yeah! Now I remember! I heard "Thank you for your patronage" over and over again this morning.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Huh? How many times? 300?

response.speaker: Sayu
response.text: Uhh, I mean, I...

choices.text: You don't have to give an exact number.

response.speaker: Sayu
response.text: Umm... ummm... ummmmm... I got it! There were at least 16 snores between each "Thank you for your patronage."

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: That's not how you count it!

response.speaker: Sayu
response.text: 16 snores should be about 1 minute, and if we add on the time for moving the boxes and stocking the shelves... mmm...

response.speaker: Player
response.text: It should take at least 5 hours to sell everything.

response.speaker: Sayu
response.text: Right! Sales only started about 4 hours ago, so there's definitely a problem with the amount!

response.speaker: Sayu
response.text: Wh—Which means, even though I only woke up just now, I still have a chance of getting my hands on one! Maybe...

response.speaker: Player
response.text: ...A miniscule chance, but yes, you're not wrong.

response.speaker: Sayu
response.text: Well, anyway! Maybe I failed my mission because a bad guy did something tricky, not because I was being lazy!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: So then, who's the bad guy?

response.speaker: Sayu
response.text: Hmm, well, the shop was pretty strict with this promotion. Not only was there a 1-per-customer limit, they even checked people's identity. So there's no way anyone could've bought more than one.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: No wonder each transaction took so long.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: And with Sara's people patrolling the area, no one could have cut the line, right?

response.speaker: Player
response.text: By process of elimination...

response.speaker: Player
response.text: The remaining option is...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: If someone was up to no good, they'd definitely try to find a way to sell the figurines at a higher price!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Let's go ask the guy who says he had to put in a lot of effort to get hold of one. Maybe he knows something!

choices.text: Roughly how long did each transaction take?
She technically should have been the first in line.

dialogues.speaker: Junpei
dialogues.text: Huh? You want to know how I got my hands on this statue? Hehehe, dream on!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Huh? Why? It's not like we're trying to buy yours off you...

dialogues.speaker: Junpei
dialogues.text: It's a no, okay? No more questions.

dialogues.speaker: Sayu
dialogues.text: Huh, how come...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: A staff member sold it to you.

dialogues.speaker: Junpei
dialogues.text: How... how did you know!?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: We're professionals.

dialogues.speaker: Sayu
dialogues.text: Huh? Oh... oh, right, yeah, we are professionals!

dialogues.speaker: Junpei
dialogues.text: Okay, fine. Since you guessed it anyway... But let me be clear — don't spread this around.

dialogues.speaker: Junpei
dialogues.text: I came here bright and early to line up, but the first batch of statues sold out almost immediately. I wasn't very happy about that, so I went around to the back door of Eipekkusu to see if I could find a shop assistant to ask about when the next batch would be coming out.

dialogues.speaker: Junpei
dialogues.text: To my surprise, I saw him moving boxes and boxes worth of statues out of the store! Needless to say, I was all ready to march up and demand to know what was going on, but...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: He gave you a figurine to keep you quiet?

dialogues.speaker: Junpei
dialogues.text: Well... uh, yes — but I paid the shop assistant full price for it, so it was still a legitimate transaction!

dialogues.speaker: Kujou Sara
dialogues.text: It's not for you to decide whether it was a legitimate transaction or not.

dialogues.speaker: Junpei
dialogues.text: Huh? It's... the Tenryou Commission?

dialogues.speaker: Kujou Sara
dialogues.text: The Tenryou Commission has received reports that someone has been hoarding goods to resell at extortionate prices. Now, these are not classed as strategic materials, so some amount of price fluctuation is expected on the market. However...

dialogues.speaker: Kujou Sara
dialogues.text: It is against the law for a staff member to abuse their position to forge sales records and misappropriate goods!

dialogues.speaker: Kujou Sara
dialogues.text: We have already investigated the situation at Eipekkusu. The sales records are correct, but in the cash box, there are two bags in which most of the cash has been replaced with stones.

dialogues.speaker: Junpei
dialogues.text: But... but how can this be?

dialogues.speaker: Kujou Sara
dialogues.text: Please hand over your "Statue of Her Excellency, the Almighty Narukami Ogosho, God of Thunder" as evidence. We will compensate you for your loss once we catch the individual responsible.

dialogues.speaker: Junpei
dialogues.text: Ugh, fine. So this guy was cooking the books, never saw that coming...

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text: Junpei hands over the statue.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: You guys figured this out pretty quickly, Sara.

dialogues.speaker: Kujou Sara
dialogues.text: In fact, we were only just tipped off. We're still working on the logistics of the arrest operation... Hmm? Who's this...

dialogues.speaker: Sayu
dialogues.text: Yikes! I've been spotted...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: This is Sayu.

dialogues.speaker: Kujou Sara
dialogues.text: Oh, you must be the professional Lady Guuji hired? I was just wondering why I hadn't seen you yet...

dialogues.speaker: Sayu
dialogues.text: Ummm... we... we were... investigating the missing figurines... oh, I mean "Statues of Her Excellency, the Almighty Narukami Ogosho, God of Thunder"...

dialogues.speaker: Kujou Sara
dialogues.text: Is that so? Then thank you. The Tenryou Commission will take over from here. Rest assured we will get to the bottom of the matter.

dialogues.speaker: Sayu
dialogues.text: Uhhh...

dialogues.speaker: Kujou Sara
dialogues.text: ...Hmm?

dialogues.speaker: Sayu
dialogues.text: Um, umm... so, uh... about your statue...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Sayu has been lining up since last night...

dialogues.speaker: Kujou Sara
dialogues.text: Really? Thank you. So where is the "Statue of Her Excellency, the Almighty Narukami Ogosho, God of Thunder"?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: ...But she saw someone misappropriating the statues!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: ...Oh, yeah, yeah, yeah! Sayu spent the whole night investigating the staff! So by the time she got back, she was just too late to buy one...

dialogues.speaker: Sayu
dialogues.text: ...Yeah, right! I definitely would have made it back in time to buy one, if only it hadn't been for someone stealing the statues!

dialogues.speaker: Kujou Sara
dialogues.text: I see... So in the end, you did not manage to purchase a statue, correct?

dialogues.speaker: Sayu
dialogues.text: *sobbing*... I'm sorry...

dialogues.speaker: Kujou Sara
dialogues.text: ...Don't blame yourself. The criminal is the one responsible here. The important thing now is to devise a plan to bring him to justice as swiftly as possible.

dialogues.speaker: Sayu
dialogues.text: Mm-hmm...

dialogues.speaker: Kujou Sara
dialogues.text: According to the intelligence, the suspect has already started reselling the statues near the festival venue. But he is lying low, and operating very discreetly.

dialogues.speaker: Kujou Sara
dialogues.text: If we confront him head-on, he is likely to destroy the evidence and dash. Instead, we will seek to quietly surround him — but in order to achieve this, we will require one person to approach and distract him...

dialogues.speaker: Kujou Sara
dialogues.text: Since you've spent the whole night thoroughly investigating this situation, I can think of no one else more suitable to gain his trust than you.

dialogues.speaker: Kujou Sara
dialogues.text: Would you be willing to help the Tenryou Commission one final time?

dialogues.speaker: Sayu
dialogues.text: What? Uh, hehe, right! Leave it to us! Hahaha... haha... hah...

talks.objective: Go to the nearby transaction site
Pretend to be a potential buyer and stall for time

dialogues.speaker: Seigou
dialogues.text: Hmm? Who introduced you? I'm trying to keep a low profile here, so I'm afraid I don't take any new business except for referrals by existing customers.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: We were referred by the one who caught you stealing the statues.

dialogues.speaker: Seigou
dialogues.text: Tsk... That guy. Fine, he did technically buy from me, I suppose...

dialogues.speaker: Seigou
dialogues.text: But let me be clear. This product is highly sought-after right now. I can't sell to you at the same price he paid.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: The price has gone up again? But it's only been a few hours!

dialogues.speaker: Seigou
dialogues.text: Hmph, well you can take it or leave it. Believe me, there's plenty more room for upwards mobility on the price, it just so happens to be in my interests to get these off my hands sooner rather than later. Besides... good luck trying to find anyone else out there selling.

dialogues.speaker: Sayu
dialogues.text: #Hmm... we gotta keep negotiating as long as we can, {NICKNAME}...

choices.text: Will this figurine keep its value over time?

response.speaker: Seigou
response.text: I don't have time for this. Just name your price.

choices.text: Can you give me a little discount?

talks.objective: Pretend to be a potential buyer and stall for time

dialogues.speaker: Seigou
dialogues.text: You think this is a game or something? If you're not serious about buying, quit wasting my time. I should be moving on to my next location by now, not stuck here arguing with you...

dialogues.speaker: Kujou Sara
dialogues.text: The next location you move to will be the Police Station. You are under arrest for abusing your position for personal gain and falsifying accounts. Do not attempt to resist, the evidence is indisputable.

dialogues.speaker: Seigou
dialogues.text: The Tenryou Commission? When did you... Wait, all that negotiating...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hehehe, stick 'em up!

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text: The Tenryou Commission escorts the shop assistant back to the Police Station. Sayu's salary, much to her elation, has also been preserved...

dialogues.speaker: Kujou Sara
dialogues.text: Thank you for your help. The culprit has revealed the location where he stashed the statues. We have sent people to collect them.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Great. So once Eipekkusu has counted the goods and stocked the shelves, we can get back in the line to buy one, right?

dialogues.speaker: Sayu
dialogues.text: This time... I must complete my mission!

dialogues.speaker: Kujou Sara
dialogues.text: ...I'm afraid it's not that simple. The stolen goods will have to be kept as evidence at the Police Station for some time. They will not be available for purchase in the immediate future.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Paimon can't believe it...

dialogues.speaker: Kujou Sara
dialogues.text: I would be grateful if you could inform the shopkeeper about this. I should return to the station and see how things are going.

dialogues.speaker: Kaede
dialogues.text: ...I see. Thank you, we'll make a compensation plan and announce it as soon as possible.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Okay. Well, see you then...

dialogues.speaker: Kaede
dialogues.text: ...Wait. Hold on. Although this "Statue of Her Excellency, the Almighty Narukami Ogosho, God of Thunder" was only intended as a display item...

dialogues.speaker: Kaede
dialogues.text: Now that I think about it... why don't you have it? As a gesture of my gratitude.

dialogues.speaker: Kaede
dialogues.text: After all, it was our negligence that caused trouble for you all on this occasion. This is just a small gift, a mere token, but I do hope you can accept it.

dialogues.speaker: Sayu
dialogues.text: R—Really?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Shall we give this to Sara?

dialogues.speaker: Sayu
dialogues.text: Sounds good... As long as we give this to Sara, my mission will be completed.

dialogues.speaker: Sayu
dialogues.text: Uh oh... I've been so nervous all day, and now I can finally relax, I feel really tired all of a sudden...

dialogues.speaker: Sayu
dialogues.text: #Please, {NICKNAME}... take this figurine to the Police Station... zzz...

dialogues.speaker: Sayu
dialogues.text: Sayu... signing out...

talks.objective: Talk to Sara at the Police Station

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Sara, look what we've brought you!

dialogues.speaker: Kujou Sara
dialogues.text: Oh, is this...

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text: You take out the statue and explain what happened.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: We just grabbed it and came straight here. But now that Paimon takes a closer look at it, it's really well-made...

dialogues.speaker: Kujou Sara
dialogues.text: Of course. This is a prototype designed by Yae Publishing House's top artist and crafted by the most skilled lacquerware master in Inazuma City...

dialogues.speaker: Kujou Sara
dialogues.text: Otherwise, how could one hope to capture even one thousandth of the Almighty Shogun's majesty?

dialogues.speaker: Kujou Sara
dialogues.text: Let alone maintain it. To do that, you must buy a special kind of shrine and worship it properly.

dialogues.speaker: Kujou Sara
dialogues.text: It's also essential to clean it often to avoid a buildup of dust, and it's best practice to hire a craftsman to perform regular maintenance...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Sara... Sara!

dialogues.speaker: Kujou Sara
dialogues.text: Hmm? What's wrong? These are the five principles for maintenance of the "Statue of Her Excellency, the Almighty Narukami Ogosho, God of Thunder," and I haven't even finished explaining the first one...

dialogues.speaker: Ei
dialogues.text: I never knew there was such a fuss over these tiny figurines... I'm surprised Miko never mentioned it to me.

dialogues.speaker: Kujou Sara
dialogues.text: Y—Your Excellency!? This is most unexpected...

dialogues.speaker: Ei
dialogues.text: I had some spare time, so I decided to come out for a stroll. Oh, did you buy this figurine yourself?

dialogues.speaker: Kujou Sara
dialogues.text: I... it's... it was...

dialogues.speaker: Kujou Sara
dialogues.text: #It was {F#her}{M#him.}

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hey, what—

response.speaker: Ei
response.text: #Oh, I didn't know you liked little trinkets like these, {NICKNAME}.

response.speaker: Kujou Sara
response.text: Your Excellency... I've yet to finish the defense arrangements for the Irodori Festival. Please excuse me.

response.speaker: Ei
response.text: Very well. Thank you.

response.speaker: Black Screen
response.text: Sara leaves, her head lowered...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Watching Sara leave... she looked kinda sad.

response.speaker: Ei
response.text: #...{NICKNAME}, I have another such figurine in Tenshukaku, a sample sent by Yae Publishing House. I don't need it, so I think I will gift it to you.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: But we already have one...

response.speaker: Ei
response.text: I shall not go back on my word. I have committed to giving it to you, what you choose to do with it is your business. You are quite free to give it to somebody else, if you wish.

response.speaker: Ei
response.text: Or, to save you the trouble, I can have someone from Tenshukaku deliver it directly. But of course, your name will have to be written as the sender.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Whew, why does all this have to be so complicated...

choices.text: Just send it to the Tenryou Commission, please.

response.speaker: Ei
response.text: Good. I'll have someone attend to this shortly.

response.speaker: Ei
response.text: Oh — and I wish you a pleasant and enjoyable Irodori Festival.

dialogues.speaker: Seigou
dialogues.text: Deal. Let's schedule a time for you to pick up the product.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hold on! Paimon thinks that price is still a little too high...

dialogues.speaker: Seigou
dialogues.text: You think that's high? Hmph, it'll be at least double that in a few days!

dialogues.speaker: Seigou
dialogues.text: Ugh, fine, fine. I swear if I wasn't in a rush to get rid of them... Hmph!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hold on! Uh, Paimon thinks there's still some room for negotiation...

dialogues.speaker: Seigou
dialogues.text: What's to negotiate? Do you want it or not!?

dialogues.speaker: Seigou
dialogues.text: Hmm... No way. That's too low with the market for this product right now.

dialogues.speaker: Seigou
dialogues.text: Hey! At that price, why don't you just ask me to give it to you for free!?

dialogues.speaker: Seigou
dialogues.text: Enough. I don't have any more time to waste on you.

dialogues.speaker: Sayu
dialogues.text: (If you incline your ear to this wooden barrel, you can hear soft snoring. Best you not disturb her beauty sleep, you suppose.)

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Although Sara didn't say anything, she seemed a little disappointed, don't you think?

dialogues.speaker: Sayu
dialogues.text: Awwww... is there really nothing we can do?
